svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Mockup 04: Modules: on, off, status, settings
svg.text: Every part of the platform in one table: what it is, how it is doing, its switch and its settings. Switching off asks first and says what happens.
Use case: an organiser sets up which parts this event uses, and switches one off mid-event without losing anything (1280 px and 390 px)

g.text: Switch on the parts this event uses. Off hides a part and stops what it would do; its data stays.
Voice rooms for teams and talk
Off · not used at this event
Off · no stream at this event

svg.text: A · 1280 px: a table, because parts are compared column by column; an off part keeps its row and its settings
B · 390 px: one row per part, the switch at hand

g.text: Food leaves the menu and the hub;
its pages say it is not at this event.
Pizza orders stay in the run of show,
but nothing opens, closes or reminds.
The food box leaves the screens
and Food’s Discord commands go away.
They stay as they are, hidden.
Nothing is deleted. Switch Food on again
and everything is where you left it.

svg.text: C · switching off says what happens first
Notes: one switch per module, on by default (D2). The run of show cannot be switched off: it is the event’s one schedule (U4).
Live work is never refused or lost: it waits, hidden, until the part is on again (E1). A loaded profile sets the switches (D8).
